measured_costs_x_realtime.machine: 4-core laptop i7-1065G7 (8 threads, 15 W; throttles under sustained load)
measured_costs_x_realtime.budget: 3.0x realtime for Part A + Part B together; overrun wipes both

decisions.finding: Part B's harness decode of the 4K 10-bit file alone costs 1.2-3.0x realtime
decisions.decision: Part A must not decode every frame too: two full decodes cannot fit in 3x.

decisions.finding: Fixed 15-frame GOP: a keyframe every 0.5 s
decisions.decision: Stage 1 decodes keyframes only (PyAV skip_frame=NONKEY): 0.11-0.12x instead of a full decode.

decisions.finding: Frame threading (thread_type AUTO) decodes every packet regardless of skip_frame (0.61x vs 0.14x)
decisions.decision: Slice threading in src/avdecode.py; a test pins it.

decisions.finding: 0.5 s apart, a walking pedestrian's box does not overlap its earlier box (IoU < 0.2 in 90-94%)
decisions.decision: Own ByteTrack association with a motion term (src/tracker.py): 4/10 -> 8/10 CP3 jaywalking events reproduced.

decisions.finding: At 2 samples/s platoons of cars alias: tracks drift backwards
decisions.decision: wrong_way and congestion only run with samples <= 0.2 s apart (optional dense mode).

decisions.finding: A starved Part A scores the same as a wiped video
decisions.decision: The keyframe baseline always completes; the Part B probe (median of 3) only buys optional density.

decisions.finding: The camera is re-framed between recordings (up to ~150 px)
decisions.decision: zones.json is aligned to each clip (SIFT similarity against a reference frame) inside the keyframe pass.

decisions.finding: Hashing a whole 6 GB clip for the cache key took 7-20 s of the budget
